blocks.text: CEBU CITY — A lawmaker’s call for an investigation into the deaths of a mother and her newborn at Barili District Hospital has sparked a public exchange with a Cebu provincial health official, who defended the facility’s services and personnel while urging the legislator to help address gaps in medical assistance. Rep. Karen Hope Flores-Garcia of Cebu’s 3rd District urged the Integrated Provincial Health Office (IPHO) to expedite its investigation into the deaths of a mother with placenta previa and her baby at the provincial government-run hospital.
